# Julio Cesar da Costa Reis Filho — Complete Scar Architecture Technical Dossier (llms-full.txt)
> Comprehensive machine-readable specification of the Mixture of Scars (MoS) & Associative SCache O(1) Ecosystem.

## 1. Unified Mathematical Operator
Across language models, 3D point-cloud optimal-transport flow, embodied reinforcement learning, and physical sensor streams, the Scar Architecture applies a single unified operator:

  S(X) = P_perp( Q_VQ4( R * D^-1 * X ) + U * V^T ) + W_scar

- `D^-1`: Per-channel diagonal equilibration neutralizing activation/weight outliers prior to rotation.
- `R`: Block-64 randomized Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform (`FWHT-64`) executed in shared workgroup memory.
- `Q_VQ4`: Directional 4D vector quantization over `LUT256` (`256 x vec4<f16>` = `2 KB` per matrix) combining exact Entry-0 vacuum `(0,0,0,0)`, sparse axes, `D_4` root-lattice shells, and energy-weighted Lloyd-Max centroids.
- `U * V^T`: Low-rank `INT4` residual scar (`2-Pass ASVD` for pretrained conversion, or `INT4-STE` for `Tabula Rasa` pretraining).
- `P_perp`: Orthogonal subspace projector (`P_perp_lang = I - U_lang U_lang^T` at Golden Slice `2L/3` for language-invariant knowledge routing and 3D conditioning; `P_perp_RFI` for radio-interferometric excision; `P_perp_CJK` for script-subspace logit gating).
- `W_scar`: Strict `O(1)` Widrow-Hoff delta-rule associative memory (`Δ = +0 B` across arbitrary horizon `T -> infinity`).

## 2. Live Browser & Native Engines Verified in Repository

1. **ScarNativeLM v5.0 (`public/webgpu/scarnative_v5/` & `src/lib/scarNativeEngine.ts`)**:
   - Zero `nn.Linear` layers; trained from `step t = 0` with `ScarNativeLinear` (`0.000000` KL PTQ shock) and `DifferentiableSCacheAttention` (`O(1)` `Δ = +0 B`).
   - `16` closed-form `Zero-SGD` Reduced-Rank Regression (`RRR`) cartridges minted in English firing across `PT/EN/ES/FR`, with exact `0x00` GDPR unlearning (`Δlogits = 0.00000000`).
   - Executed by `22` custom `WGSL 1.0` compute shaders (`cos > 0.99999` vs PyTorch).

2. **Mixture of Scars (MoS) 72.7B & Qwen2.5-3B JARVIS (`public/webgpu/qwen3b/` & `src/lib/mosWebgpuEngine.ts`)**:
   - `72.7B` single-GPU streaming in `<= 2.40 GB` peak VRAM across all 80 layers.
   - `Qwen2.5-3B` `Track 2.5 ProtectedInt4Scar` (`1,601.55 MiB`, 36 layers) running in-browser via WebGPU WGSL with constant `SCache O(1)` (`Δ +0 B`) and `41` `HTTP/1.1 206 Partial Content` conceptual cartridges (`143,360 B` each) routed at `Layer 23` (`P_perp_lang`).
   - Causal-split out-of-cone epistemic guard when `0` ScarStore cartridges fire + deterministic neural-motor constellation face (`zero Math.random()`).

3. **PointScarFlow v1.0 (`public/webgpu/pointscar_v1/` & `src/lib/pointScarFlowEngine.ts`)**:
   - Continuous 3D Optimal-Transport Rectified Flow (`11,852,614` `ScarNativeLinear` parameters, `3.87 MiB` shard, `12` `WGSL 1.0` compute shaders, `zero` preset shape catalog).
   - Integrates `1,024` 3D points in `4` guided Euler steps (`86.45 ms` median on Apple M2 WebGPU) directly from `Qwen2.5-3B` `Layer 23` `P_perp_lang` latents.
   - `7.51x` held-out Chamfer-L2 reduction vs sphere baseline (`0.0621` vs `0.4663`); cross-lingual 3D shape cosine `PT<->EN = 0.9978`, `ES<->EN = 0.9977`, `FR<->EN = 0.9974`.

4. **ScarCodec v4.0 (`src/lib/physicalScarCodec.ts` & `src/components/PhysicalScarLab.tsx`)**:
   - Radio-Astronomy `1,000x` RFI excision (`cos = 0.9923`, `5.75x` compression).
   - Aerospace Black-Box `34,816 B` `O(1)` telemetry (`5/5` faults retained across `8,000+` frames, `Δ = 0 B`).
   - HDR CFD Shock Field (`12.05x` compression, exact `0.0` vacuum error, `O(1)` block decode).

5. **AURA / System One (`src/components/SystemOneHudDemo.tsx` & `https://github.com/byte-od/system_one`)**:
   - Birthplace of `34.8 KB` `O(1)` `GradientScarMemory` (`Surprise = R_0 - V(s_0)`), Frontier Ghost-Jump Scouts (`> 2,000 FPS` lookahead), and `Tri-Compass`.
   - `0.23 ms` P50 bare-CPU `UniversalS1Agent` solving Rubik's Cube scrambles up to Depth 10 (`232.2B` states) with zero tree search.
